review_scope: Independently checked the source key set, all 10 titles, 70 article section headings, all 23 FAQ questions and answers, all audit flags, garment and backpack variants, parcel events, and numerical scenarios against English. Sampled the surrounding article prose.

corrections.translation: Kako na fotografijah pregleda OOTDBuy prepoznati izbrano različico izdelka

corrections.translation: Katere podatke shraniti, ko se ponudba iz preglednice OOTDBuy spremeni

corrections.source: The OOTDBuy listing has a colour name but no photo. Which option should you choose?
corrections.translation: Ponudba na OOTDBuy navaja barvo brez fotografije. Katero možnost izbrati?

corrections.source: How to save a Weidian link from OOTDBuy without losing the style you chose
corrections.translation: Kako z OOTDBuy shraniti povezavo na Weidian in zabeležiti izbrano različico

corrections.source: Comparing two OOTDBuy size charts when neither uses your usual measurements
corrections.translation: Kako primerjati tabeli velikosti OOTDBuy, če nobena ne uporablja običajnega načina merjenja

corrections.source: Reading an OOTDBuy product gallery when the photographs tell different stories
corrections.translation: Kako brati galerijo izdelka na OOTDBuy, ko fotografije kažejo različne podrobnosti

corrections.source: How to document a damaged item for an OOTDBuy after-sales request
corrections.translation: Kako dokumentirati poškodovan izdelek za zahtevek pri poprodajni podpori OOTDBuy

corrections.translation: Koliko stane izdelek, ki ga najdete na OOTDBuy, skupaj z dostavo?

corrections.translation: Kako načrtovati pakiranje različnih izdelkov v en paket OOTDBuy

corrections.translation: Kako izslediti zadnji zabeleženi dogodek pri dostavi paketa OOTDBuy

corrections.source: OOTDBuy shopping and delivery guides
corrections.translation: Vodniki za nakupovanje in dostavo z OOTDBuy

corrections.source: Trace a Weidian listing, compare size charts, read warehouse photos and follow an OOTDBuy parcel from packing through delivery.
corrections.translation: Poiščite prvotno ponudbo na Weidianu, primerjajte tabele velikosti in fotografije iz skladišča ter sledite paketu OOTDBuy od pakiranja do dostave.

corrections.source: OOTDBuy spreadsheet FAQ
corrections.translation: Pogosta vprašanja o nakupovalni preglednici OOTDBuy

corrections.source: Which link should I save from an OOTDBuy spreadsheet row?
corrections.translation: Kateri povezavi naj shranim iz vrstice preglednice OOTDBuy?

corrections.source: Save the seller listing and the OOTDBuy purchase page. Note the marketplace, item number and selected option text. If the agent link later opens an empty page, the original listing gives you a way to check whether the seller still offers that option.
corrections.translation: Shranite prodajalčevo ponudbo in stran za nakup na OOTDBuy. Zapišite tržnico, oznako izdelka in točno ime izbrane različice. Če povezava posrednika pozneje odpre prazno stran, lahko v izvirni ponudbi preverite, ali je različica še na voljo.

corrections.source: Can I use a catalogue photo to find a missing product?
corrections.translation: Ali lahko manjkajoči izdelek poiščem s fotografijo iz kataloga?

corrections.source: Open Image search from the navigation and upload a crop showing one item. Compare distinctive features in the results, then open the seller listing and check the identifier. A close visual match can come from a different seller.
corrections.translation: V meniju odprite slikovno iskanje in naložite izrez z enim izdelkom. Primerjajte značilne podrobnosti, nato odprite ponudbo in preverite oznako izdelka. Zelo podobno fotografijo lahko uporablja drug prodajalec.

corrections.source: What if two almost identical jackets appear in search?
corrections.translation: Kako v zadetkih ločim dve skoraj enaki jakni?

corrections.source: Compare pocket position, zip pulls and panel seams in the detail pictures. Then compare seller, item ID and option text. Keep both links until you can explain which listing matches the jacket you want.
corrections.translation: Na podrobnih fotografijah primerjajte položaj žepov, jezičke zadrg in šive med deli blaga. Nato preverite prodajalca, oznako izdelka in ime različice. Shranite obe povezavi, dokler ne ugotovite, katera ponudba ustreza iskani jakni.

corrections.source: Does a copied Weidian link remember my size?
corrections.translation: Ali kopirana povezava Weidian ohrani mojo velikost?

corrections.source: Reopen the copied link and check the selected options. Keep the exact colour and size text alongside it. Some links identify a listing with several choices and reopen at its default selection.
corrections.translation: Znova odprite povezavo in preverite izbrane možnosti. Ob njej shranite natančni oznaki barve in velikosti. Nekatere povezave vodijo do ponudbe z več različicami in ob odprtju prikažejo privzeto možnost.

corrections.source: How can I tell a style photograph from a detail photograph?
corrections.translation: Kako ločim fotografijo izbrane različice od fotografije podrobnosti?

corrections.source: Select two styles in succession and watch which image changes with the choice. Use that image to identify the option. Use the gallery below it to inspect features such as fasteners or lining, and verify which style those gallery pictures depict.
corrections.translation: Zaporedoma izberite dve različici in poglejte, katera slika se spremeni. Ta pomaga prepoznati izbiro. V spodnji galeriji preverite zapenjanje, podlogo in druge podrobnosti ter ugotovite, katero različico slike dejansko prikazujejo.

corrections.source: Which number should I use to compare two Weidian links?
corrections.translation: Katero številko primerjam pri dveh povezavah Weidian?

corrections.source: Compare the itemID on the seller pages. Matching numbers identify the same listing on Weidian. Also compare the size, colour and package choice because multiple options can share that number.
corrections.translation: Primerjajte polje itemID na prodajalčevih straneh. Enak identifikator na Weidianu označuje isto ponudbo. Preverite še velikost, barvo in izbrani komplet, saj si različne možnosti lahko delijo isti identifikator.

corrections.source: Does a missing style photograph mean that colour is sold out?
corrections.translation: Ali manjkajoča fotografija različice pomeni, da je barva razprodana?

corrections.source: Check whether the exact colour can be selected on the live seller or agent page. A catalogue can have a name for a colour without having a picture for it. Use the live option status when deciding whether to order.
corrections.translation: Na aktualni strani prodajalca ali posrednika preverite, ali lahko izberete točno to barvo. Katalogu lahko manjka slika tudi pri dobavljivi različici. Če izbira ni jasna, jo pred plačilom preverite.

corrections.source: Why can the lowest displayed price change when I choose a style?
corrections.translation: Zakaj se najnižja prikazana cena po izbiri različice spremeni?

corrections.source: Check which option the initial price describes. A listing may include a single accessory, a garment and a set. After selecting your option, read the unit, quantity and subtotal together before comparing prices.
corrections.translation: Preverite, na katero možnost se nanaša začetna cena. V isti ponudbi so lahko samostojen dodatek, oblačilo in celoten komplet. Izberite želeno različico ter pred primerjavo preverite prodajno enoto, količino in vmesni znesek.

corrections.source: How do I check whether a listing includes both pieces of a set?
corrections.translation: Kako preverim, ali ponudba vključuje oba dela kompleta?

corrections.source: Read the seller option text for the top, bottom or complete set. Save the wording and inspect the order summary. A model wearing two pieces in one picture does not establish that the seller supplies both.
corrections.translation: Preberite, ali izbrana možnost označuje zgornji del, spodnji del ali ves komplet. Shranite besedilo in preverite povzetek naročila. Če model na sliki nosi oba kosa, to še ne dokazuje, da sta oba vključena.

corrections.source: What does a historical QC picture tell me?
corrections.translation: Kaj pove starejša fotografija pregleda v skladišču?

corrections.source: It can show visible details of a unit photographed earlier. Match the marketplace listing, option and identifying features before using it. For a decision about your current order, ask to see the item tied to your order number.
corrections.translation: Vidite lahko podrobnosti prej fotografiranega primerka. Najprej primerjajte ponudbo, različico in prepoznavne značilnosti. Za odločitev o svojem naročilu prosite za sliko artikla, povezanega z vašo številko naročila.

corrections.source: Can I judge colour from one warehouse picture?
corrections.translation: Ali lahko barvo ocenim iz ene skladiščne fotografije?

corrections.source: Look for a neutral item in the same frame and compare several views. If colour determines whether you will keep the item, ask for a closer view under neutral light with the option label visible. Screen settings and lighting can change its appearance.
corrections.translation: V istem kadru poiščite nevtralno obarvan predmet in primerjajte več pogledov. Če je barva odločilna, prosite za bližnji posnetek pri nevtralni svetlobi z vidno oznako različice. Osvetlitev in nastavitve zaslona vplivajo na videz.

corrections.source: How should I compare a flat chest measurement to my own shirt?
corrections.translation: Kako širino čez prsi primerjam s svojo srajco?

corrections.source: Lay a shirt that fits flat, without stretching it. Measure from underarm seam to underarm seam. Compare with a photo using the same endpoints and units. A chart giving chest circumference uses a different measurement.
corrections.translation: Srajco, ki vam ustreza, položite ravno in je ne raztegujte. Izmerite razdaljo med šivoma pod pazduhama. Primerjajte fotografijo z enakima točkama in enoto. Obseg prsnega dela je drugačna mera.

corrections.source: What makes a tape-measure photo usable?
corrections.translation: Kdaj je fotografija z merilnim trakom uporabna?

corrections.source: Both endpoints, the zero mark and the reading should be visible in one view. Check that the tape follows the requested path and lies flat. A close-up of a number alone cannot show which part was measured.
corrections.translation: V istem kadru morajo biti obe skrajni točki, ničla in odčitek. Preverite, ali trak leži ravno in sledi zahtevani poti. Bližnji posnetek številke same ne pokaže, kateri del so merili.

corrections.source: How do I check a shoe-size label?
corrections.translation: Kako preverim oznako velikosti čevlja?

corrections.source: Ask for a clear picture of the label and compare the exact sizing system and printed size with the order. If length matters, define whether you need removable insole length or another measurement before requesting a photo.
corrections.translation: Prosite za jasno fotografijo etikete ter z naročilom primerjajte natisnjeno velikost in sistem številčenja. Če je pomembna dolžina, pred fotografiranjem povejte, ali potrebujete dolžino odstranljivega vložka ali drugo mero.

corrections.source: Which pictures help when a set is missing a piece?
corrections.translation: Katere fotografije pomagajo, če manjka del kompleta?

corrections.source: Save the seller option description, your order confirmation and one picture showing everything received together. Identify the missing piece by name and contact OOTDBuy from the order while the item can still be inspected.
corrections.translation: Shranite opis izbrane možnosti, potrdilo naročila in fotografijo vseh prejetih delov skupaj. Manjkajoči del poimenujte ter se prek naročila obrnite na OOTDBuy, dokler je artikel še mogoče pregledati v skladišču.

corrections.source: Which price should I use for a budget in my own currency?
corrections.translation: Katero ceno uporabim za proračun v svoji valuti?

corrections.source: Start with the live price for your chosen option and quantity. Record the original currency, conversion rate and time of comparison. At payment, check the currency and total on the actual checkout screen.
corrections.translation: Začnite pri trenutni ceni izbrane različice in količine. Zapišite izvirno valuto, menjalni tečaj in čas primerjave. Na plačilnem zaslonu nato preverite valuto in končni znesek.

corrections.source: Does the item price include international delivery?
corrections.translation: Ali je mednarodna dostava vključena v ceno izdelka?

corrections.source: Read the item checkout and parcel quote separately. Record any seller-to-warehouse delivery charge on the purchase side. For the outbound parcel, check the destination, route, packing and services shown in the current quote.
corrections.translation: Ločeno preberite povzetek nakupa in ponudbo za pošiljanje paketa. K nakupu prištejte morebitno dostavo od prodajalca do skladišča. Pri odhodnem paketu v aktualni ponudbi preverite cilj, pot, pakiranje in storitve.

corrections.source: What should I record when comparing parcel estimates?
corrections.translation: Kaj zabeležim pri primerjavi dveh ocen poštnine?

corrections.source: Use the same destination, weight, dimensions, units and contents on both estimates. Save the route name and included services beside each result. A cheaper figure based on a smaller assumed box is a different comparison.
corrections.translation: Pri obeh uporabite isti cilj, težo, dimenzije, enote in vsebino. Ob vsakem rezultatu shranite ime poti in vključene storitve. Nižji znesek, ki predpostavlja manjšo škatlo, ni neposredno primerljiv.

corrections.source: How do I decide whether to keep the original retail box?
corrections.translation: Kako se odločim, ali naj obdržim originalno prodajno škatlo?

corrections.source: Write down what the box does for this item, such as supporting a fragile shape or keeping pieces together. Compare the available packing options and ask about effects on return eligibility before authorizing disposal.
corrections.translation: Zapišite, čemu služi škatla, na primer ali podpira občutljivo obliko ali drži dele skupaj. Primerjajte možnosti pakiranja in pred odobritvijo odstranitve vprašajte, kako bi ta vplivala na možnost vračila.

corrections.source: Where should I check the storage deadline?
corrections.translation: Kje preverim rok skladiščenja?

corrections.source: Check the warehouse entry for the specific item and consult Storage in the OOTDBuy Help Center. For items that arrived on different dates, record the deadline for each entry before waiting for the rest of the order.
corrections.translation: Preverite skladiščni vpis posameznega artikla in razdelek »Storage« v centru za pomoč OOTDBuy. Če so artikli prispeli ob različnih datumih, pred čakanjem na preostanek naročila zapišite rok za vsakega posebej.

corrections.source: Which tracking number belongs to the outbound shipment?
corrections.translation: Katera sledilna številka pripada paketu, ki je odšel iz skladišča?

corrections.source: Match the number on your international parcel record to the carrier shown there. Keep the seller's domestic delivery number separately. Its delivery scan can refer to arrival at the warehouse.
corrections.translation: Uporabite številko in prevoznika iz evidence mednarodnega paketa. Številko prodajalčeve domače pošiljke hranite posebej, saj lahko njena oznaka »dostavljeno« pomeni prihod v skladišče.

corrections.source: How do I report damage after delivery?
corrections.translation: Kako po dostavi prijavim poškodbo?

corrections.source: Keep the parcel label and packaging. Photograph the outer box, internal protection, affected item and damaged area. Send the parcel reference and a description through OOTDBuy's after-sales channel and check its current reporting conditions.
corrections.translation: Shranite nalepko in embalažo. Fotografirajte zunanjo škatlo, notranjo zaščito, prizadeti artikel in mesto poškodbe. Referenco paketa in opis pošljite prek poprodajne podpore OOTDBuy ter preverite aktualne pogoje za prijavo.

corrections.source: Where can I check OOTDBuy return, inspection and delivery rules?
corrections.translation: Kje najdem pravila OOTDBuy za vračila, pregled in dostavo?

corrections.source: Open the official Help Center. The Shopping Agent Guide covers returns, Warehouse & After-sale covers inspection and storage, and Delivery covers packaging and charges. For an individual order, include its reference when contacting support.
corrections.translation: Odprite uradni center za pomoč. »Shopping Agent Guide« zajema vračila, »Warehouse & After-sale« pregled in hrambo, »Delivery« pa pakiranje in stroške. Če sprašujete o določenem naročilu, podpori sporočite njegovo referenco.

corrections.source: Imagine that your own flat width is 56 centimetres and a chart lists a chest of 112 centimetres. Those figures could describe similar widths if the chart gives a whole garment circumference. If the chart describes a body measurement instead, the comparison changes completely. Read the diagram or ask how the measurement was taken. This is an illustrative calculation. For your actual order, use the chart attached to the exact version you selected and a photograph with the tape visible if precise fit will decide whether you keep it.
corrections.translation: Recimo, da je vaša srajca na ravni podlagi široka 56 cm, v tabeli pa pri prsih piše 112 cm. Vrednosti lahko opisujeta podobno širino, če je 112 cm obseg celotnega oblačila. Če gre za obseg telesa, je primerjava drugačna. Poglejte skico ali vprašajte, kako je prodajalec meril. Za dejanski nakup uporabite tabelo izbrane različice in po potrebi fotografijo z vidnim merilnim trakom.

corrections.source: For example, suppose your saved note says “one brown bag with strap, 120 yuan.” The live page shows 95 yuan as soon as it opens, then 125 yuan after you choose the version with strap. The comparable change in this example is five yuan. The apparent saving of 25 yuan depends on a different selection. Before changing your budget, check the seller's description of what comes with the 95-yuan option. The numbers here illustrate how to make the comparison; use the values displayed for your own item.
corrections.translation: Recimo, da je v zapisku zapisano »ena rjava torba s trakom, 120 juanov«. Trenutna stran se odpre s ceno 95 juanov, po izbiri različice s trakom pa pokaže 125 juanov. Primerljiva razlika je torej 5 juanov. Navidezni prihranek 25 juanov bi veljal za drugo izbiro. Pred spremembo proračuna preberite, kaj prodajalec ponuja za 95 juanov. Številke ponazarjajo postopek, za nakup pa uporabite cene svojih izbranih različic.

corrections.source: Consider this example message. “I want the olive option marked G2, size medium. The spreadsheet thumbnail is empty. Please use G2 only and contact me if this version is unavailable. The black cover picture is not my choice.” It gives the reader a selection, a size and an instruction for an exception. If the seller uses a different label, quote its wording instead of inventing your own code. Keep the screenshot with the note in case the order page later changes.
corrections.translation: Primer sporočila: »Želim olivno zeleno različico z oznako G2 v velikosti M. V preglednici ni sličice. Prosim, uporabite samo G2 in me obvestite, če je ni. Črna različica na naslovni fotografiji ni moja izbira.« Tako navedete različico, velikost in navodilo za primer nedobavljivosti. Če prodajalec uporablja drugo oznako, prepišite njegovo besedilo. Ob sporočilu shranite posnetek zaslona za primer poznejše spremembe strani.

corrections.source: If you would accept an alternative, define the limit in the same message. “Silver or grey fittings are acceptable; please ask before substituting the black bag” is a different instruction from “any similar colour is fine.” Check how the agent actually records the note and selection before paying. Save a copy of the confirmed option. The note and the selected line should agree; a note asking for olive beside a paid line for black creates avoidable uncertainty.
corrections.translation: Če bi sprejeli zamenjavo, v istem sporočilu določite meje. »Srebrni ali sivi kovinski deli so v redu. Preden izberete črno torbo, me vprašajte« pomeni nekaj drugega kot »primerna bo katerakoli podobna barva«. Pred plačilom preverite, kako je posrednik shranil izbiro in opombo, ter shranite potrjeno različico. Opomba o olivno zeleni torbi ob plačani črni različici povzroči dvom, ki bi se mu lahko izognili.

corrections.source: If the page loads and your exact option is greyed out, distinguish that case from a dead listing. Write “page available, navy B in L currently unavailable” rather than marking the entire find as broken. A second buyer looking for medium can still check that option. A buyer who needs large now knows what to ask about. The difference also matters when updating a shared spreadsheet: deleting an entire row can hide other choices that remain usable.
corrections.translation: Če se stran odpre, a želenega izdelka ne morete izbrati, celotna ponudba s tem še ni nedosegljiva. Zapišite na primer »stran deluje, temno modra B v velikosti L trenutno ni na voljo«. Kupec, ki išče M, lahko to možnost še vedno preveri, kupec za L pa ve, kaj mora vprašati. Tudi v skupni preglednici ne brišite vse vrstice zaradi ene možnosti, saj bi skrili druge uporabne izbire.

corrections.source: Two jackets look equally suitable in an OOTDBuy spreadsheet. In one listing the medium has a chest of 58; in the other the large has a bust of 116. Those figures could describe nearly the same garment. They could also describe entirely different things. Before choosing between them, identify who or what was measured, which two points the tape touched and which garment needs to fit underneath.
corrections.translation: V preglednici OOTDBuy sta videti primerni dve jakni. V eni ponudbi pri prsih za velikost M piše 58, v drugi pa za L piše 116. Številki lahko opisujeta skoraj enaki oblačili ali pa popolnoma različni meri. Pred izbiro ugotovite, ali je bilo izmerjeno telo ali oblačilo, med katerima točkama je potekal trak in kaj boste nosili pod jakno.

corrections.source: Take a working example. Your reference jacket is 58 cm from underarm to underarm. Listing A gives a flat width of 57 cm at the same points. Listing B gives a finished garment circumference of 116 cm, explicitly measured around the chest. Roughly doubling the flat reference gives 116 cm, so B looks closer on this dimension. That does not establish identical fit. Thick material, curved seams and different armholes can make the simple doubling rule imprecise. The two chart values are now interpretable, which is the point of the exercise.
corrections.translation: Vaša primerjalna jakna meri med pazduhama 58 cm. Ponudba A navaja 57 cm med istima točkama na položenem oblačilu. Ponudba B navaja obseg gotove jakne okoli prsi 116 cm. Dvakrat 58 cm je 116 cm, zato je B po tej meri bližje. To še ne pomeni enakega prileganja. Debelina blaga, ukrivljeni šivi in rokavni izrezi omejujejo natančnost podvajanja. Zdaj vsaj veste, kaj pomenita vrednosti iz tabel.

corrections.source: Imagine you record 68 cm from the high shoulder and 65 cm down the centre back. A listing showing a centre-back length of 66 cm is about one centimetre longer by the corresponding method. Comparing it with 68 cm would lead you to call it shorter. With a cropped jacket the mistaken conclusion can affect whether the hem clears your waistband. If the listing omits the starting point, ask for the method rather than guessing which convention the seller used.
corrections.translation: Denimo, da od najvišje točke rame izmerite 68 cm, po sredini hrbta pa 65 cm. Jakna, ki po sredini hrbta meri 66 cm, je po ustrezni metodi približno 1 cm daljša. Če jo primerjate z 68 cm, bi jo napačno opisali kot krajšo. Pri kratki jakni to vpliva na to, kam sega rob glede na pas hlač. Če začetna točka ni navedena, vprašajte, kako je bila mera zajeta.

corrections.source: To check a photograph, trace the path of the tape with your eye. Is the cuff turned up? Is the sleeve bent or stretched? Does the zero mark sit on the seam you requested? A close crop of the final number can be completely legible and still answer the wrong question. If you have only one additional view available, request a single frame showing the entire path. Include the size and colour in the request so the photographer measures the item you plan to keep.
corrections.translation: Na fotografiji sledite celotni poti traku. Je manšeta zavihana, rokav upognjen ali raztegnjen? Je ničla na zahtevanem šivu? Na tesnem izrezu je številka lahko povsem čitljiva, a odgovarja na napačno vprašanje. Če lahko dobite le še en posnetek, prosite za celotno pot traku v enem kadru. Dodajte velikost in barvo, da bodo merili pravi kos.

corrections.source: A sweatshirt-and-trousers set may use one size selector even though the top and bottom have separate charts. Compare both pieces before choosing. For trousers, decide which measurement matters most for your use: relaxed waist, seat width, rise, inseam or the opening that must pass over your shoe. A seller's flat relaxed waist tells you something different from a stretched maximum. Ask whether a quoted pair of values represents a measurement range or the ends of two different sizes.
corrections.translation: Komplet jopice in hlač lahko uporablja eno izbiro velikosti, čeprav ima vsak kos svojo tabelo. Primerjajte oba. Pri hlačah določite pomembno mero: sproščen pas, širino čez boke, višino sedala, dolžino notranjega šiva ali širino hlačnice čez čevelj. Sproščena širina pasu ni enaka največji raztegnjeni. Če prodajalec navede dve vrednosti, vprašajte, ali gre za razpon iste velikosti ali za meri dveh različnih velikosti.

corrections.source: If your measuring tape uses inches and the seller uses centimetres, convert your own reference once using 2.54 centimetres per inch. A 22.5-inch flat chest is 57.15 cm. Keeping 57.2 cm for comparison is usually more practical than repeatedly converting a chart column and rounding it to whole inches. Retain the original reading as well. It allows you to spot a transcription error if one result seems far outside the range of your other clothing.
corrections.translation: Če vaš trak kaže palce, prodajalec pa centimetre, svojo mero enkrat pretvorite po razmerju 2,54 cm na palec. Širina čez prsi 22,5 palca znaša 57,15 cm. Za primerjavo običajno zadošča 57,2 cm. Tako se izognete večkratnemu preračunavanju preglednice in zaokroževanju na cele palce. Shranite tudi izvirni odčitek, da lahko prepoznate napako pri prepisovanju, če vrednost odstopa od drugih vaših oblačil.

corrections.source: A dimension drawing, colour chart or instructions panel can appear between photographs with little explanation. Check the labels around it. The diagram may apply to the whole family, a named model or the packaging rather than the product. In the backpack example, outside dimensions do not give the exact dimensions of an internal laptop sleeve. Padding, rounded corners and an opening narrower than the body all matter. Ask for sleeve width and usable opening if you need to carry a specific object.
corrections.translation: Med fotografijami je lahko skica mer, vzorčnik barv ali navodilo brez jasne razlage. Preverite oznake: skica se lahko nanaša na celo družino izdelkov, imenovani model ali embalažo. Zunanje mere nahrbtnika ne razkrivajo natančnih mer notranjega predala za prenosnik. Pomembni so oblazinjenje, zaobljeni vogali in odprtina, ki je lahko ožja od predala. Za konkretno napravo vprašajte po notranji širini in uporabni širini odprtine.

corrections.source: You do not need to annotate every image. List the contradictions that affect your requirements. For the backpack you might record three: the outside pocket appears only in the studio picture, the dark green option has no front view, and the sleeve drawing has no internal width. Beside each, identify the simplest evidence that would settle it. A front photograph of the selected bag answers two of those questions at once. A measurement of the sleeve opening addresses the third.
corrections.translation: Ni treba komentirati vsake slike. Zapišite nasprotja, ki vplivajo na izbiro. Pri nahrbtniku je zunanji žep morda viden le na studijski sliki, temno zelena različica nima pogleda od spredaj, na skici predala za prenosnik pa manjka notranja širina. Za vsako določite najpreprostejši dokaz. Fotografija izbrane torbe od spredaj razreši prvi dve vprašanji, meritev odprtine predala pa tretje.

corrections.source: Send the request with the seller option text and a description of the relevant location. “Please show the front of the dark green full-size bag, then the width of its laptop sleeve opening with the tape visible” gives the reader a reproducible task. If the item is in your order, add its reference in the private OOTDBuy order channel. For available inspection services and the stage at which you can request them, consult the official Help Center and the current order interface.
corrections.translation: Zahtevi dodajte prodajalčevo ime različice in opišite natančno mesto: »Pokažite sprednjo stran temno zelenega nahrbtnika polne velikosti, nato z vidnim trakom izmerite širino odprtine njegovega predala za prenosnik.« Če je nahrbtnik že naročen, dodajte njegovo referenco v zasebni kanal naročila OOTDBuy. Razpoložljive preglede in trenutek, ko jih lahko zahtevate, preverite v uradnem centru za pomoč in prikazu naročila.

corrections.source: When reviewing pictures of your own unit, bring back the same landmarks and the same contradiction list. Match the order option first. Then decide whether the photographs answer your essential requirements. A visible outside zip answers the pocket question; it does not establish laptop clearance. A sleeve measurement can support your size decision but does not settle whether a detachable organizer is included. Keep each conclusion with the evidence that supports it.
corrections.translation: Na fotografijah svojega primerka poiščite iste značilnosti in ponovno preverite ista neskladja. Najprej potrdite naročeno različico. Vidna zunanja zadrga odgovori na vprašanje o žepu, ne pa na to, ali gre prenosnik skozi odprtino. Meritev predala pomaga oceniti velikost, ne dokazuje pa, da je priložen odstranljivi organizator. Vsako ugotovitev povežite z dokazom, ki jo podpira.

corrections.source: At the end you should be able to explain the choice in plain terms. You might decide that the exact shade matters little, that a usable sleeve opening matters a great deal, and that the organizer can be purchased separately. Someone with different priorities can reasonably reach another conclusion from the same photographs. A good reading of an OOTDBuy gallery gives you that freedom. It turns a long, sometimes inconsistent collection of pictures into a short set of observations that actually changes what you do.
corrections.translation: Na koncu bi morali izbiro znati preprosto pojasniti. Morda natančen odtenek ni odločilen, uporabna odprtina predala za prenosnik je nujna, organizator pa lahko kupite posebej. Kupec z drugačnimi potrebami se lahko ob istih fotografijah odloči drugače. Branje galerije OOTDBuy tako dolg in včasih neskladen niz slik spremeni v nekaj opažanj, po katerih sprejmete odločitev.

corrections.source: Consider an illustrative shopping list. You choose two shirts at 80 yuan each and one bag at 120 yuan. The item subtotal is 280 yuan. For now put that figure in a column labelled goods. Keep any accessory that you might add later on a separate draft line. Mixing alternatives with confirmed selections is an easy way to inflate your budget, while leaving an accessory out of a complete-set comparison can make one offer look cheaper than it really is.
corrections.translation: Denimo, da kupujete dve srajci po 80 juanov in torbo za 120 juanov. Skupna vrednost blaga je 280 juanov. Vpišite jo v stolpec »Blago«. Dodatek, o katerem še razmišljate, naj za zdaj ostane v ločeni vrstici. Če alternative prištejete že izbranim izdelkom, bo proračun previsok. Če pri primerjavi celih kompletov izpustite potreben dodatek, pa se lahko ena ponudba zdi cenejša, kot je v resnici.

corrections.source: Next, inspect the live purchase summary for domestic delivery. One seller may charge for an entire order; another may display a delivery amount on each line. Check the calculation shown for the combination you chose. In the example, suppose the two shirts share an eight-yuan domestic charge and the bag has a separate six-yuan domestic charge. Your purchase-stage total becomes 294 yuan before any other applicable payment or service charges. Charging eight yuan to each shirt would overstate the total by eight.
corrections.translation: V trenutnem povzetku nakupa preverite dostavo znotraj Kitajske. En prodajalec jo lahko zaračuna enkrat za celotno naročilo, drugi jo prikaže pri vsaki postavki. Preverite izračun za izbrano kombinacijo. Če skupna dostava dveh srajc stane 8 juanov, ločena dostava torbe pa 6 juanov, je vmesni znesek nakupa 294 juanov brez morebitnih plačilnih ali storitvenih provizij. Če vsaki srajci prištejete 8 juanov, je skupni znesek za 8 juanov previsok.

corrections.source: Suppose a calculator returns an illustrative 165 yuan for one particular set of inputs. That is a planning figure for the whole proposed parcel. Do not add 165 yuan to each item. Add it once to the purchase-stage total, giving a provisional 459 yuan in this example. If a packing option later costs 12 yuan, the revised planning total is 471 yuan. These are arithmetic examples, not OOTDBuy rates. Use the options available for your contents and destination, and confirm the amount shown before payment.
corrections.translation: Denimo, da kalkulator za izbrane podatke pokaže 165 juanov. Ocena velja za celoten načrtovani paket. Znesku nakupa zato enkrat prištejete 165 juanov in dobite začasno vsoto 459 juanov. Če pozneje izberete še pakiranje za 12 juanov, nova ocena znaša 471 juanov. Te številke ponazarjajo račun. Za dejanski znesek na OOTDBuy izberite možnosti, ki ustrezajo vsebini in cilju pošiljke, ter ga pred plačilom preverite.

corrections.source: In the example, an equal three-way allocation of the illustrative 165-yuan freight gives 55 yuan to each seller unit. Allocating by item value would assign each 80-yuan shirt about 47.14 yuan and the 120-yuan bag about 70.71 yuan before rounding adjustment. Those figures are bookkeeping choices. If the bag determines most of the box size, the group may prefer a separate comparison with and without the bag. Use one rule for settlement, record the rounding difference and ensure the shares add back to the actual parcel charge.
corrections.translation: Če 165 juanov prevoznine enakomerno razdelite med tri izdelke, vsakemu pripade 55 juanov. Pri delitvi po vrednosti pripade vsaki srajci za 80 juanov približno 47,14 juana, torbi za 120 juanov pa 70,71 juana, preden poračunate razliko zaradi zaokroževanja. O delitvi stroška se dogovorite sami. Če predvsem torba določa velikost škatle, primerjajte oceno z njo in brez nje. Za poravnavo uporabite eno pravilo, zapišite razliko zaradi zaokroževanja in preverite, ali vsota deležev ustreza dejanski prevoznini.

corrections.source: Examine what the original box or insert does. An insert can hold a rigid handle in position, keep two pieces apart or keep a small component from vanishing. A larger outer sleeve might mainly add empty volume. Treat them as separate decisions. “Keep the shaped insert and the accessory pouch; the outer display sleeve can be removed if permitted” is more informative than “remove boxes.” If the warehouse offers only broad choices, ask what the selected option actually removes.
corrections.translation: Preverite namen izvirne škatle in vložka. Oblikovani vložek lahko pritrdi tog ročaj, loči dva dela ali prepreči izgubo drobnega sestavnega dela. Večji zunanji prodajni ovoj morda doda predvsem prazen prostor. O vsakem kosu odločite posebej. Na primer napišite »Obdržite oblikovani vložek in vrečko z dodatki. Zunanji prodajni ovoj lahko odstranite, če je dovoljeno.« Če skladišče ponuja le splošne možnosti, vprašajte, kaj bodo pri izbrani možnosti dejansko odstranili.

corrections.source: As an illustration, suppose one proposed carton measures 40 by 30 by 20 centimetres. Its outside volume is 24,000 cubic centimetres. Adding five centimetres to the height changes that to 30,000, a 25 percent increase in volume. The actual weight might change very little. The price consequence depends on the line's billing rules, rounding and applicable limits. This example explains why dimensions deserve a place in your notes; it does not give an OOTDBuy rate, divisor or guaranteed saving from removing a box.
corrections.translation: Predlagana škatla naj ima zunanje mere 40 × 30 × 20 cm. Njena prostornina znaša 24.000 cm³. Če višino povečate za 5 cm, prostornina naraste na 30.000 cm³, torej za 25 %. Dejanska masa se lahko spremeni le malo. Vpliv na ceno je odvisen od obračunskih pravil proge, zaokroževanja in veljavnih omejitev. Primer pokaže, zakaj si je smiselno zapisati mere. Iz njega ne morete določiti tarife OOTDBuy, delitelja za prostorninsko maso ali zagotovljenega prihranka ob odstranitvi škatle.

corrections.source: When the parcel arrives, compare its label to your outbound reference. If something appears damaged, document the outer condition and internal protection as you uncover them. Keep the packaging while you consult the applicable after-sales instructions. If everything arrives as expected, write down what worked. A note such as “shaped insert preserved the bag; display sleeve was unnecessary for my use” is more transferable to your next mixed parcel than a bare freight total.
corrections.translation: Ko paket prispe, primerjajte oznako z referenco odhodne pošiljke. Če opazite poškodbo, med odpiranjem dokumentirajte stanje zunanje embalaže in notranje zaščite. Embalažo obdržite, dokler ne preverite navodil za uveljavljanje zahtevka. Če je vse prispelo po pričakovanjih, si zapišite, kaj je delovalo. Opomba »oblikovani vložek je zaščitil torbo, zunanjega prodajnega ovoja pa nisem potreboval« bo pri naslednjem mešanem paketu uporabnejša od samega zneska prevoznine.

corrections.source: Imagine an order containing a jacket and scarf. On Monday the jacket's seller reference ends with a domestic delivery scan. On Thursday the jacket and scarf appear together in one international parcel record with another reference. Later a destination operator reports that it has received electronic information about that parcel. These events describe three different observations. The first supports checking warehouse receipt of the jacket, the second identifies your requested outbound contents, and the third records a message in the destination carrier's network.
corrections.translation: Predstavljajte si naročilo jakne in šala. V ponedeljek zadnji zapis pod prodajalčevo številko za jakno kaže dostavo na Kitajskem. V četrtek sta jakna in šal skupaj vpisana v mednarodni paket z drugo številko. Pozneje prevoznik v ciljni državi sporoči, da je prejel elektronske podatke o njem. Prvi dogodek je podlaga za preverjanje prevzema jakne v skladišču. Drugi opredeli izdelke, ki ste jih izbrali za odpremo. Tretji potrjuje prejem sporočila v omrežju ciljnega prevoznika.

corrections.source: When you receive the parcel, compare the label with the outbound reference and check the contents against the items assigned to it. If the parcel arrived but one garment is missing, close the delivery question and open a contents question with the relevant packaging and item evidence. If support confirms another outcome, retain the written resolution and identify precisely which parcel it covers. The result should let another reader tell which delivery was completed, which issue was investigated and whether any separate purchase is still in transit.
corrections.translation: Ob prevzemu primerjajte nalepko s številko odhodne pošiljke in vsebino s seznamom izdelkov v tem paketu. Če paket prispe, manjka pa eno oblačilo, zaključite vprašanje o dostavi in odprite ločeno vprašanje o vsebini. Priložite dokazila o embalaži in izdelkih. Če podpora potrdi drugačen izid, shranite pisni odgovor in jasno označite paket, ki ga zadeva. Iz zapisa naj bo razvidno, katera pošiljka je prispela, kaj je bilo preverjeno in ali je kateri drug nakup še na poti.

corrections.source: Start with the decision the photograph needs to answer
corrections.translation: Določite, kaj morate ugotoviti s fotografije

corrections.source: Trace the reference back to the seller listing
corrections.translation: Poiščite prvotni prodajalčev oglas

corrections.source: Identify the option inside the listing
corrections.translation: V oglasu poiščite pravo različico izdelka

corrections.source: Choose a useful historical QC photograph
corrections.translation: Izberite uporabno fotografijo prejšnjega pregleda

corrections.source: Check measurements with a comparison garment
corrections.translation: Mere primerjajte z oblačilom, ki ga nosite

corrections.source: Request a photograph that resolves the uncertainty
corrections.translation: Prosite za fotografijo, ki bo odpravila konkretni dvom

corrections.source: Make the decision against the actual order
corrections.translation: Odločite se na podlagi podatkov o svojem naročilu

corrections.source: Choose a useful starting point
corrections.translation: Izberite primerno izhodišče za primerjavo

corrections.source: Keep the marketplace identity separate from the agent view
corrections.translation: Ločite oglas na tržnici od prikaza pri posredniku

corrections.source: Distinguish a changed option from a changed price
corrections.translation: Preverite, ali se je spremenila različica ali cena

corrections.source: Deal with an option that has disappeared
corrections.translation: Kaj storiti, če izbrana različica izgine

corrections.source: Keep chronology when purchase has already happened
corrections.translation: Po nakupu ohranite časovni potek sprememb

corrections.source: Update a shared spreadsheet without erasing the earlier decision
corrections.translation: Posodobite skupno preglednico, ne da bi izbrisali prejšnjo odločitev

corrections.source: Decide whether the change matters
corrections.translation: Presodite, ali sprememba vpliva na vaš nakup

corrections.source: Read the complete option, including the suffix
corrections.translation: Preberite celotno oznako različice, vključno s končnico

corrections.source: Check stock independently of the gallery
corrections.translation: Preverite zalogo neodvisno od fotografij v galeriji

corrections.source: Use other photographs for the details they actually show
corrections.translation: Na drugih fotografijah preverjajte le podrobnosti, ki jih dejansko kažejo

corrections.source: Compare shades under sensible conditions
corrections.translation: Odtenke primerjajte v primerljivih pogojih

corrections.source: Make your purchase note unambiguous
corrections.translation: Navodilo za nakup napišite nedvoumno

corrections.source: Review the received unit, then close the decision
corrections.translation: Preglejte prejeti izdelek in zapišite končni izid

corrections.source: Decide which destination the recipient needs
corrections.translation: Ugotovite, katero povezavo potrebuje prejemnik

corrections.source: Read the listing identity from the opened page
corrections.translation: Na odprti strani preverite podatke za prepoznavo oglasa

corrections.source: Build a minimum option record
corrections.translation: Zapišite osnovne podatke o izbrani različici

corrections.source: Test the link without your existing selection
corrections.translation: Preizkusite povezavo brez že izbrane različice

corrections.source: Keep the product identity through a change of agent
corrections.translation: Tudi ob menjavi posrednika ohranite podatke za prepoznavo izdelka

corrections.source: Handle a changed or unavailable seller page
corrections.translation: Kaj storiti, če se prodajalčeva stran spremeni ali postane nedostopna

corrections.source: Give the recipient a usable handoff
corrections.translation: Povezavi priložite podatke, ki jih prejemnik potrebuje

corrections.source: Pick a reference you actually wear
corrections.translation: Za primerjavo izberite oblačilo, ki ga nosite

corrections.source: Identify garment dimensions and body recommendations
corrections.translation: Ločite mere oblačila od priporočenih telesnih mer

corrections.source: Match the length definition before comparing numbers
corrections.translation: Pred primerjavo preverite, od kod so merili dolžino

corrections.source: Account for shoulder shape when comparing sleeves
corrections.translation: Pri primerjavi rokavov upoštevajte ramenski kroj

corrections.source: Read a set as two garments
corrections.translation: V kompletu preverite mere vsakega oblačila posebej

corrections.source: Convert once and keep the original figures
corrections.translation: Mere pretvorite enkrat in shranite izvirne vrednosti

corrections.source: Write the buying decision while the charts are visible
corrections.translation: Odločitev zapišite, dokler imate tabeli velikosti pred seboj

corrections.source: Begin with the object outline
corrections.translation: Najprej si oglejte obris izdelka

corrections.source: Read option photographs as part of the selector
corrections.translation: Fotografije različic povežite z ustreznimi izbirami

corrections.source: Work outward from a detail picture
corrections.translation: Podrobnost na bližnjem posnetku umestite v celoten izdelek

corrections.source: Identify graphics and diagrams
corrections.translation: Ločite risbe in sheme od fotografij izdelka

corrections.source: Separate historical QC from seller presentation
corrections.translation: Ločite fotografije prejšnjih pregledov od prodajalčevih predstavitvenih slik

corrections.source: Make a contradiction list you can act on
corrections.translation: Zapišite neskladja, ki jih je še mogoče razjasniti

corrections.source: Use the gallery when the item arrives
corrections.translation: Prejeti izdelek primerjajte s slikami v galeriji

corrections.source: First establish when the problem became visible
corrections.translation: Ugotovite, kdaj je poškodba postala vidna

corrections.source: Preserve the relationship between item, box and protection
corrections.translation: Pokažite, kako je bil izdelek zaščiten v škatli

corrections.source: Photograph the issue in context
corrections.translation: Poškodbo fotografirajte skupaj z okolico

corrections.source: Reconstruct the records before writing the request
corrections.translation: Pred oddajo zahtevka sestavite potek dogodkov

corrections.source: Write a short, specific first message
corrections.translation: Prvo sporočilo naj bo kratko in konkretno

corrections.source: Respond to follow-up requests without losing the original record
corrections.translation: Odgovorite na dodatna vprašanja in ohranite prvotna dokazila

corrections.source: Close the file when the outcome is clear
corrections.translation: Primer zaključite, ko je izid jasen

corrections.source: Fix the purchase units before adding any delivery
corrections.translation: Pred prištevanjem dostave določite nakupne enote

corrections.source: Count seller-to-warehouse delivery once
corrections.translation: Dostavo od prodajalca do skladišča upoštevajte le enkrat

corrections.source: Give the outbound parcel its own record
corrections.translation: Za paket iz skladišča odprite ločen zapis

corrections.source: Compare routes using the same parcel
corrections.translation: Poti primerjajte z enakimi podatki o paketu

corrections.source: Allocate a shared cost only when it answers a real question
corrections.translation: Skupni strošek razdelite le takrat, ko tak podatek potrebujete

corrections.source: Handle currency without counting the conversion twice
corrections.translation: Pazite, da valute ne preračunate dvakrat

corrections.source: Reconcile the estimate after the final payment
corrections.translation: Po zadnjem plačilu primerjajte oceno z dejanskim stroškom

corrections.source: Make an inventory of shapes and surfaces
corrections.translation: Opišite oblike in površine izdelkov

corrections.source: Look for conflicts between the items
corrections.translation: Preverite, ali bi se lahko izdelki med seboj poškodovali

corrections.source: Work out which retail packaging does useful work
corrections.translation: Preverite, kateri deli prodajne embalaže izdelek res ščitijo

corrections.source: Compare two practical scenarios
corrections.translation: Primerjajte dve izvedljivi možnosti pakiranja

corrections.source: Ask for the information that changes the choice
corrections.translation: Prosite za podatke, ki bi vplivali na odločitev

corrections.source: Review the submission screen as a parcel
corrections.translation: Pred potrditvijo preglejte podatke o celotnem paketu

corrections.source: Keep a short unpacking record
corrections.translation: Med odpiranjem na kratko zabeležite stanje

corrections.source: Start with the parcel you expected to receive
corrections.translation: Najprej ugotovite, kateri paket ste pričakovali

corrections.source: Copy the latest event in its original wording
corrections.translation: Prepišite zadnje obvestilo o sledenju v izvirni obliki

corrections.source: Follow the handoff using the carrier's own description
corrections.translation: Predaji sledite po prevoznikovem opisu dogodka

corrections.source: Work through an example with two tracking numbers
corrections.translation: Primer z dvema sledilnima številkama

corrections.source: Read the action requested by the latest status
corrections.translation: Preverite, ali zadnje obvestilo od vas zahteva ukrepanje

corrections.source: Send an inquiry that can be followed from the first line
corrections.translation: Poizvedbo začnite s podatki, po katerih je mogoče poiskati pošiljko

corrections.source: Close the timeline only when the outcome is clear
corrections.translation: Časovni pregled zaključite, ko je izid znan
